title: Luke Skywalker
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
description: Luke Skywalker grew up on the remote desert world of Tatooine. Residing just outside Anchorhead, Luke was raised by his Uncle Owen and Aunt Beru Lars. Often dreaming of life off-world, Skywalker split his time between working for his uncle's moisture farm and wasting time with his friends, often rocketing through Beggars Canyon in his T-16 Skyhopper.
